_why: Text that may carry a birth year in the 80-year window although no living person is meant, because the line records a death.

Read by tools/check_living_v2.py rule 7 and by the kit's printed-year gate (checkliving.py --years, standard.json living_years). Each entry is a decision: add one only where a death is recorded beside the year, or where the year is not a birth at all.

allow.why: Queensland death registration 1988/9150, parents Angelo Mazza and Francesca Strano: a registered death, a different household from the tree's Giovanni Mazza (data/qld-bdm.tsv). Flagged to David: the year equals a living namesake's, so the two may be one man.
The date a wall was established by reading (data/walls.json), printed under a person whose birth year sits just before it; it is a research date, not anyone's birth.
